recover from illness: It took Grandma two months to fully recover from illness, but now she walks in the park every morning.
奶奶花了兩個月才完全病癒，但現在她每天早上都在公園散步。
recover one's losses: After losing money on the stock market, he worked two jobs to recover his losses as quickly as possible.
在股市賠錢後，他兼兩份工作，想盡快挽回損失。
recover stolen goods: The police were able to recover stolen goods worth over a million dollars from the thieves' warehouse.
警方從竊賊的倉庫中追回價值超過一百萬元的失物。
recover one's composure: The speaker dropped her notes on stage, but she quickly recovered her composure and continued her talk.
講者在台上掉了講稿，但她很快恢復鎮定，繼續演講。
the economy recovered: After the pandemic ended, the economy recovered slowly as tourists returned and shops reopened.
疫情結束後，隨著觀光客回流、商店重新開張，經濟慢慢復甦。
recover consciousness: The driver was hurt in the accident and did not recover consciousness until the next day in the hospital.
司機在車禍中受傷，直到隔天在醫院才恢復意識。
recruit volunteers: The animal shelter hopes to recruit volunteers who can walk the dogs and clean the cages on weekends.
動物收容所希望招募志工，在週末遛狗和清理籠子。
recruit staff: Before the new hotel opens, the manager must recruit staff for the front desk and the restaurant.
新飯店開幕前，經理必須為櫃台和餐廳招聘員工。
recruit members: To recruit members for the dance club, the students put up colorful posters all around the school.
為了替舞蹈社吸收成員，學生們在校園各處張貼彩色海報。
a new recruit: As a new recruit on the basketball team, Kevin still had a lot to learn from the older players.
身為籃球隊的新成員，凱文還有很多要向學長學習的地方。
recycle paper: Our class decided to recycle paper by putting a special box next to the door for used worksheets.
我們班決定回收紙張，在門邊放一個專門收集用過講義的箱子。
recycle old ideas: Critics said the movie lazily recycles old ideas that we have already seen in dozens of other films.
影評說這部電影偷懶地老調重彈，盡是我們在其他數十部電影看過的點子。
recycle a joke: Uncle Bob recycles a joke he has told at every family dinner for ten years, but we still laugh.
鮑伯叔叔重複一個他十年來每次家庭聚餐都講的老笑話，但我們還是會笑。
reduce costs: To reduce costs, the company turned off the air conditioners at night and printed fewer documents.
為了降低成本，公司晚上關掉冷氣，並減少列印文件。
be reduced to tears: The little girl was reduced to tears when she found that her favorite toy had been broken.
小女孩發現她最喜歡的玩具被弄壞時，哭了出來。
reduce the risk: Wearing a helmet can greatly reduce the risk of serious head injuries when you ride a bike.
騎腳踏車時戴安全帽可以大大降低頭部重傷的風險。
be reduced to begging: After losing his job and his home, the man was reduced to begging for food on the street.
失去工作和房子之後，那名男子淪落到在街頭乞討食物。
reduce speed: Drivers must reduce speed near schools because children may suddenly run across the road.
駕駛在學校附近必須減速，因為孩子可能會突然衝過馬路。
reduce the sauce: The chef told us to reduce the sauce over low heat until it became thick and rich.
主廚叫我們用小火把醬汁收乾，直到它變得濃稠香醇。
reduce to ashes: The big fire last night reduced the old wooden temple to ashes in less than an hour.
昨晚的大火在不到一小時內就把那座老木造廟宇化為灰燼。
refer to a dictionary: When you see a word you don't know, you can refer to a dictionary to check its meaning.
看到不認識的字時，你可以查字典確認它的意思。
refer to someone as: His classmates refer to him as "the walking dictionary" because he knows so many English words.
他的同學稱他為「活字典」，因為他懂好多英文單字。
refer a patient to a specialist: When the medicine did not help, the doctor decided to refer the patient to a specialist at a big hospital.
藥物無效時，醫生決定把病人轉診給大醫院的專科醫生。
refer to the matter: The principal did not refer to the matter again, hoping that everyone would soon forget the fight.
校長沒有再提及此事，希望大家很快就會忘了那場打架。
refer back to: If you forget the rules during the test, you may refer back to the instructions on the first page.
考試時如果忘了規則，你可以回頭參考第一頁的說明。
refine a method: The scientists spent years trying to refine a method for turning seawater into clean drinking water.
科學家花了好幾年改進一種把海水變成乾淨飲用水的方法。
refine one's skills: She practices every afternoon to refine her skills before the national piano competition next month.
她每天下午練習，以在下個月的全國鋼琴比賽前精進技能。
refine oil: The factory near the harbor was built to refine oil that arrives on ships from the Middle East.
港口附近的那座工廠是為了煉製從中東船運來的油而建的。
refine a theory: After collecting more data, the professor was able to refine a theory he had first suggested ten years ago.
收集更多數據後，教授得以完善他十年前首次提出的理論。
refined taste: My aunt has refined taste in art, so her apartment is full of beautiful paintings and elegant furniture.
我阿姨在藝術上有高雅品味，所以她的公寓裡滿是美麗的畫作和雅致的家具。
